chunks: We would have seized him by his right hand,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says He would seize the disbeliever by the right hand?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the immediacy of divine retribution, where 'taking by the right hand' signifies a direct, inescapable grasp by God, often interpreted as the Angel of Death or divine power itself. It serves as a dramatic prelude to the severing of the aorta (al-‘abd al-lub), symbolizing the separation of the soul from the body and the certainty of accountability for those who deny the truth.
